title.en: Open a workspace in the browser from the agent list
title.zh: 可从智能体列表直接在浏览器中打开工作区

description.en: Agents also stay in the order they were added, whatever their status or activity.
description.zh: 列表按添加顺序固定排列，不再随状态或活动变化调整位置。

title.en: Clearer connection test for relays that only accept coding tools
title.zh: 仅支持编程工具的中转站，连接测试不再误报

description.en: Such an endpoint turns away the direct test, so the result now says it cannot be checked here instead of reporting the key as failed.
description.zh: 这类接口会拒绝直连测试，现在结果会说明无法在此检测，不再显示为密钥校验失败。

description.en: Agent progress folds into short summaries, code blocks gain highlighting and a copy button, and the message box is redesigned.
description.zh: 智能体进度收起为摘要，代码块支持高亮与复制，输入框焕新。

title.en: A refreshed workspace sidebar and title bar
title.zh: 工作区侧栏与标题栏焕新

title.en: A consistent look across workspace pages
title.zh: 工作区各页面风格统一

description.en: Settings, files, knowledge, issues and other pages now share the same cards, lists and controls. Unread counts are shown in red throughout, and the sidebar footer shows your account with search above it.
description.zh: 设置、文件、知识库、议题等页面统一采用相同的卡片、列表与控件；未读数统一以红色标示，侧栏底部显示当前账户，搜索位于其上方。
